highlight: Fresh 2022 paint & interior. Pro Line 4, Gogo AVANCE L3 Wi-Fi, thrust reversers.
overview:
This 2002 Beechjet 400A presents exceptionally well, with both paint and interior completed in 2022. Powered by Pratt & Whitney JT15D-5R engines on a TBO Extension STC, she carries a full Collins Pro Line 4 avionics suite and is equipped for modern operations — Gogo AVANCE L3 Wi-Fi, ADS-B, RVSM certification, TCAS-II with Change 7, and EGPWS.

The seven-passenger cabin is finished in custom brown slate leather with dual fold-out tables, a fully-enclosed lavatory with sink, and USB power at the cockpit and VIP seat. A clean, well-equipped, thrust-reverser-equipped light jet ready for its next owner.
